meta.area: Las Vegas Strip and immediately adjacent casino resorts
meta.scope: Provisional two-guest hotel comparison for December 12-16, 2026. A separate nine-night December 12-21 scenario is included as supplemental context because the WPT World Championship at Wynn runs December 13-20, 2026.
meta.booking_status: No hotel is booked. Rates and availability are dynamic snapshots, not reservations or guarantees.
meta.currency_rule: Do not convert Treasure Island's Accor rates from EUR to USD; no exchange-rate source was collected. Compare hotels only when currency, tax/fee inclusion, occupancy, and stay dates are understood.
meta.tax_method: The official Clark County lodging-tax document states 13.38% for resort hotels in the Primary Gaming Corridor. This rate is used only for clearly labeled Wynn and Venetian illustrations where the booking page did not provide an all-in total. It is not a substitute for a live booking total.
meta.route_method: Walking figures are Google Maps route estimates checked on 2026-11-16, not future guarantees. Property interiors, access changes, closures, and route availability may add time or invalidate a route.
meta.interpretation: A missing quote, parser placeholder, or booking-engine error is not evidence that a hotel is sold out. Conditional advertised starting rates are not date-specific quotes.

hotels.venue_context: The WPT World Championship is scheduled at Wynn Dec 13-20, 2026; its room rates below are separate from any tournament entry costs.

quotes.offer_name: Your Fall to Have It All
quotes.estimate_method: Displayed average nightly rate x 4 nights, then 13.38% lodging tax. The booking page displayed an average, not an itemized total; this arithmetic is illustrative only.
quotes.cancellation_terms: The offer terms state a credit card is required, one night's room rate and tax is charged at booking, and cancellation at least 72 hours before arrival avoids a one-night room-rate-and-tax penalty.
quotes.notes: The seasonal offer must be booked by Nov 24, 2026. It applies to eligible Resort King or Two Queens stays; confirm the offer and current rate in checkout. The $55 nightly resort fee is included in the displayed rate and is not added again.

hotels.name: The Venetian Resort Las Vegas (including The Palazzo rate program)
hotels.venue_context: The Venetian is a tournament venue; walking estimates from Treasure Island and Wynn are listed below.

quotes.notes: The official booking query returned $XXX placeholders and an inconsistent 4+ guest/capacity message, not a usable two-guest rate. Do not interpret this as sold out. The separate poker-suite page advertises rates starting as low as $119 and $209, but gives no confirmed Dec 12-16 rate; both floor totals above are illustrative arithmetic, not quotes.
quotes.conditions: Poker rate must be booked through the resort using code EPOKR25 and is subject to availability and blackout dates. For each night stayed, listed guests must collectively complete six hours of active live cash play or buy into a $300+ tournament by 2 a.m. on the last night stayed; otherwise the rate adjusts to the prevailing rate. A $55 nightly resort fee plus applicable tax applies.

general_caveats: All hotel rates are time-sensitive snapshots retrieved on 2026-11-16. Re-price and check availability before booking.
The four-night Dec 12-16 window is provisional; the nine-night Dec 12-21 comparison is supplemental only. Neither is a confirmed user itinerary.
Quoted amount, estimated total, advertised rate floor, and failed/no-quote status are represented separately. Do not present an estimate or starting rate as an official stay total.
Resort fees and taxes can change. Parking, incidental holds, optional services, transport, meals, and tournament entry costs are not included unless explicitly itemized.
Walking times are current route estimates, not guarantees. Google Maps flagged the Resorts World-Venetian path for private/restricted areas; check for a public route.
T-01 found no reviewed event certified as strict single-entry with no re-entry, rebuy, add-on, or paid chip advantage. Hotel proximity is not an endorsement of a tournament as qualifying.
